observation.command: echo "=== listening ports ==="; ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E "8080|8081|4200|4300|3000|5432|7700" ; echo "=== curl frontend dev ports ==="; for p in 4200 4300 4201; do echo -n "$p -> "; curl -s -m 3 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:$p 2>&1 || echo "no server"; done; echo "=== github packages probe ==="; curl -s -m 10 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://npm.pkg.github.com/@sw-code%2furbo-core
